**The document doesn't report HumanEval results for Adapted Parallel-RL or any other model.** The paper evaluates code only with LiveCodeBench (Appendix A.1, p. 13). HumanEval's source paper (Chen et al., 2021) is cited only for the unbiased pass@k estimator (Appendix E.4, p. 26).

The closest reported numbers are Adapted Parallel-RL's LiveCodeBench accuracy with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B:

| Setting | LiveCodeBench accuracy | Change vs. single-task RL | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Full-parameter GRPO | 22.5% | +0.9 | Table 4, p. 6 |
| LoRA GRPO | 17.3% | −0.5 | Table 6, p. 24 |
| Full-parameter PPO | 19.5% | −0.8 | Table 6, p. 24 |

These are accuracy figures. The paper doesn't explicitly label them as pass@1.

The paper's pass@k analysis covers only Naive Parallel-RL, not Adapted Parallel-RL. It uses LiveCodeBench for code and presents the results as curves in Figure 7, without listed pass@1 values (Appendix E.4, p. 26).
